articles.summary: Year Over Year CAVA Revenue Growth of 22.1% Including Same Restaurant Sales of 3.1% 24 Net New CAVA Restaurant Openings During Quarter Third Quarter 2026 CAVA Restaurant-level Profit Margin of 23.4% CAVA Group, Inc. (NYSE: CAVA) (“CAVA Group” or the “Company”), the category-defining Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant brand that brings heart, health, and humanity to food, today announced financial results for its fiscal third quarter ended October 4, 2026. “In the third quarter, despite broader industry pressures, we continued to gain market share, expand our footprint, and see strong performance from our new restaurants,” said Brett Schulman, Co-Founder and CEO. “Same Restaurant Sales grew 3.1%, CAVA Revenue increased 22.1%, and we opened our 500th restaurant ahead of schedule.
